notice: 200 original text pattern cards. Not model training, not 200 captured or visually audited product screens. Related sources are study leads, not evidence of implementation.

patterns.title: Outcome-led product hero
patterns.composition: Pair a short outcome headline with a readable crop demonstrating that outcome; subordinate app chrome
patterns.avoid: Shrinking a whole dashboard into illegible proof
patterns.review: Can a visitor connect the headline to a visible product action?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Editorial split hero
patterns.composition: Use an asymmetric text/visual balance, deliberate headline breaks and one primary action aligned to the copy
patterns.avoid: An equal grid with no dominant element
patterns.review: Does the compact version preserve the same reading order?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Immersive landscape hero
patterns.job: Connect a product to a contextual world
patterns.composition: Place concise copy in genuine negative space; isolate a product excerpt against the scene
patterns.avoid: Placing text across a busy image or decorative landscape without relevance
patterns.review: Inspect crop, contrast and static fallback at both widths
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Object-led hero
patterns.job: Explain a distinctive physical or digital object
patterns.composition: Give one object dominant scale with controlled light and a restrained supporting interface
patterns.avoid: Unrelated metallic ornaments competing with the offer
patterns.review: Is the object meaningful without its caption?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Typography-led hero
patterns.composition: Use a strong type relationship, sparse supporting content and a deliberate baseline for the CTA
patterns.avoid: Oversized words that hide what the product does
patterns.review: Read with actual headline lengths and fallback fonts
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Interactive evidence hero
patterns.composition: Show a prepopulated task, clear input and useful result; keep purchase navigation outside demo state
patterns.avoid: A fake terminal or tabs with no meaningful outcome
patterns.review: Can the demo reset and remain usable without animation?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Two-sided service hero
patterns.composition: Pair each role's view around one shared event; make the connection visually explicit
patterns.avoid: Inventing permission or recipient behavior
patterns.review: Verify both roles' facts and compact ordering
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: App-download hero
patterns.job: Connect a mobile product to a real task
patterns.composition: Use one readable device view, task-focused copy and platform-specific download action
patterns.avoid: A pile of tiny tilted phones and unsupported platform badges
patterns.review: Does the main screen remain readable on mobile?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Enterprise explanation hero
patterns.composition: Lead with the concrete problem, one system relationship and a useful next step
patterns.avoid: Abstract nodes and exaggerated business claims
patterns.review: Can the visitor identify who benefits and what changes?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Editorial launch announcement
patterns.composition: Separate release context, product name, capability demonstration and one exploration path
patterns.avoid: Confusing a release campaign with the main product navigation
patterns.review: Does the page remain understandable after the launch date?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Evidence-first feature section
patterns.composition: Pair a precise claim with a targeted UI state and a caption explaining the evidence
patterns.avoid: Repeating the entire dashboard
patterns.review: Is each visible detail relevant to the claim?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Before-and-after workflow
patterns.composition: Hold the task constant; compare the actual steps or artifacts in aligned columns
patterns.avoid: Invented time savings and unfair comparisons
patterns.review: Are assumptions and measured results distinguishable?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Alternating narrative scale
patterns.job: Sustain attention on a long page
patterns.composition: Alternate a dominant demonstration, concise explanation and quiet supporting proof
patterns.avoid: Equal-height card bands for every idea
patterns.review: Inspect the full-page silhouette for intentional rhythm
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Trust with provenance
patterns.composition: Place a relevant quote, source or verified assurance adjacent to the claim it supports
patterns.avoid: Fabricated logos, metrics or security badges
patterns.review: Can every trust signal be traced to approved evidence?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Pricing decision surface
patterns.composition: Align comparable features and billing units; distinguish recommendation from availability
patterns.avoid: Making the highest price the only clear action
patterns.review: Check monthly/annual totals and narrow comparison behavior
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Integration landscape
patterns.composition: Group actual integrations by job and show one connected workflow
patterns.avoid: Decorative logo clouds implying unsupported partners
patterns.review: Can the visitor distinguish supported from planned integrations?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Setup narrative
patterns.composition: Show actual milestones, required access and the first useful result
patterns.avoid: A generic three-step sequence that hides prerequisites
patterns.review: Can the visitor predict setup effort and dependencies?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Customer-story feature
patterns.composition: Anchor a genuine story in its context, challenge, product action and supported outcome
patterns.avoid: Unapproved portraits and synthetic testimonials
patterns.review: Confirm attribution and avoid implying typical results
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: FAQ by uncertainty
patterns.composition: Order questions by real purchase or use uncertainty; put essential facts outside collapsed content
patterns.avoid: Using FAQ as storage for core product explanation
patterns.review: Can users find cancellation, compatibility and support details?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Closing decision
patterns.composition: Restate the outcome briefly and present a primary action with any necessary commitment detail
patterns.avoid: A second oversized hero with unrelated claims
patterns.review: Does the CTA match earlier destinations and expectations?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Quiet canvas with concentrated accent
patterns.composition: Use neutral large surfaces; reserve saturated color for one focal region and meaningful actions
patterns.avoid: Accenting every badge, border and headline
patterns.review: Can the eye identify the main action immediately?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Dark luminous stage
patterns.composition: Keep a near-dark base, localized illumination and readable foreground hierarchy
patterns.avoid: Bloom around all text and low-contrast secondary controls
patterns.review: Check luminance separation without effects
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Soft environmental frame
patterns.composition: Separate a gentle contextual background from a crisp readable product surface
patterns.avoid: Treating mockup presentation margins as application layout
patterns.review: Does the actual app still work without the outer frame?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Bold editorial accent panel
patterns.composition: Use one large accent field, dark readable type and controlled image overlap
patterns.avoid: Copying a neon palette without brand fit
patterns.review: Test foreground contrast and compact image collisions
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Asymmetric feature mosaic
patterns.composition: Make cell sizes reflect information priority and use a common internal alignment system
patterns.avoid: A decorative bento grid of equally vague benefits
patterns.review: Can each cell's hierarchy be read independently?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Full-bleed evidence break
patterns.composition: Let a relevant visual occupy the width between quieter content groups
patterns.avoid: Full-bleed decoration that interrupts comprehension
patterns.review: Does the transition preserve orientation and contrast?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Layered product crop
patterns.composition: Overlap a few meaningful product excerpts with a clear front-to-back hierarchy
patterns.avoid: Tiny fake data and arbitrary perspective distortion
patterns.review: Can key content be read at target display size?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Monochrome with a signal color
patterns.composition: Use restrained surfaces and assign accent to selection or action; keep semantic alerts separate
patterns.avoid: Using the same strong color for all states
patterns.review: Can selection, warning and primary action be distinguished?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Warm editorial typography
patterns.composition: Balance a characterful display face with a highly readable text face and calm measures
patterns.avoid: Mixing font personalities with no hierarchy
patterns.review: Check real body copy, numerals and localization
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Precision technical surface
patterns.composition: Use disciplined alignment, tabular numbers and restrained annotations around actual evidence
patterns.avoid: Decorative pseudo-technical labels and fake telemetry
patterns.review: Do details explain the system rather than merely decorate it?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Optical icon alignment
patterns.composition: Align icon visual weight with text rather than blindly centering its bounding box
patterns.avoid: Different icon families and stroke weights in one toolbar
patterns.review: Compare adjacent controls at actual size
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Nested corner hierarchy
patterns.composition: Relate inner and outer radii to padding and surface role
patterns.avoid: The same radius on every nested shape
patterns.review: Inspect inset controls and compact cards together
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Spacing by relationship
patterns.composition: Keep label-to-value spacing tighter than item-to-item and group-to-group spacing
patterns.avoid: A single gap token applied to every relationship
patterns.review: Does grouping remain clear without dividers?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Headline wrapping control
patterns.composition: Choose measure and fluid scale around natural phrase boundaries
patterns.avoid: Hard line breaks that fail on another viewport
patterns.review: Test adjacent widths and longer localized headlines
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Subtle surface separation
patterns.composition: Use the weakest effective combination of background, border and elevation
patterns.avoid: Border plus heavy shadow plus gradient on every panel
patterns.review: Does grouping remain clear in both supported themes?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Numeric typography
patterns.composition: Use consistent units, tabular figures when useful and aligned decimals
patterns.avoid: Mixing precision and units within a comparison
patterns.review: Can values be compared by scanning a column?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Quiet metadata hierarchy
patterns.composition: Reduce emphasis through role and placement while preserving legibility
patterns.avoid: Tiny low-contrast metadata used to look sophisticated
patterns.review: Inspect actual viewing size and larger text
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Coherent illustration treatment
patterns.job: Make assets feel native to the brand
patterns.composition: Match palette, perspective, lighting and level of detail across assets
patterns.avoid: Combining unrelated stock, 3D and line art without a concept
patterns.review: Would the assets still look related without surrounding UI?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Purposeful negative space
patterns.composition: Allocate breathing room according to importance and content density
patterns.avoid: Empty space that pushes useful content far below the fold
patterns.review: Compare opening screen and full-page rhythm
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: State-consistent controls
patterns.composition: Carry geometry and type through default, focus, hover, pending and disabled states
patterns.avoid: Polishing only the default screenshot
patterns.review: Compare the entire state strip at identical dimensions
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: List-detail workspace
patterns.job: Browse and inspect without losing place
patterns.composition: Show list and detail together when space permits; preserve selection when collapsing
patterns.avoid: Resetting list scroll on every return
patterns.review: Select, resize, go back and verify context survives
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Task-oriented sidebar
patterns.composition: Group destinations by user job and keep active location distinct from hover
patterns.avoid: A flat wall of equally weighted links
patterns.review: Can users distinguish destination from action?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Bottom navigation
patterns.composition: Use a small stable set with meaningful labels and persistent selection
patterns.avoid: Turning secondary commands into main destinations
patterns.review: Check back behavior and large text labels
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Command palette
patterns.composition: Group commands and destinations, expose shortcuts and preserve a discoverable menu path
patterns.avoid: Making keyboard shortcuts the only access
patterns.review: Can a new user complete the same task without shortcuts?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Breadcrumb hierarchy
patterns.composition: Show meaningful ancestors with current item as context
patterns.avoid: Using breadcrumbs as a browsing-history trail
patterns.review: Does each ancestor lead to the expected parent?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Local tabs
patterns.composition: Keep labels short, active state clear and panel context stable
patterns.avoid: Using tabs for unrelated navigation levels
patterns.review: Test keyboard selection and deep-link expectations
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Workspace switcher
patterns.composition: Separate account identity from active workspace and retain context where safe
patterns.avoid: Ambiguous actions that cross organizational boundaries
patterns.review: Can the user always identify which workspace receives an action?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Progressive disclosure menu
patterns.composition: Expose frequent commands and group infrequent ones behind a labeled affordance
patterns.avoid: Hiding critical recovery under an unlabeled icon
patterns.review: Can the action be found with touch and keyboard?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Navigation rail adaptation
patterns.composition: Translate compact navigation into a rail or sidebar based on available space
patterns.avoid: Changing terminology as the window grows
patterns.review: Does the same destination remain recognizable across sizes?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Deep-link recovery
patterns.composition: Reconstruct necessary context and show a useful fallback for missing items
patterns.avoid: A blank detail page without navigation
patterns.review: Open an expired or unauthorized link and inspect recovery
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Search with scoped results
patterns.composition: Show query, scope, result count and recognizable result metadata together
patterns.avoid: Unexplained mixed result types
patterns.review: Can users tell why an item matched?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Faceted filtering
patterns.composition: Expose relevant facets, active filters and an obvious reset
patterns.avoid: Filters that silently remove all results
patterns.review: Check empty results and retained query state
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Search suggestions
patterns.composition: Separate recent, suggested and exact results with clear labels
patterns.avoid: Suggestions that unexpectedly submit a destructive action
patterns.review: Test keyboard, composition input and cancellation
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Saved views
patterns.composition: Let users name a meaningful filter/sort combination and show unsaved changes
patterns.avoid: Saving hidden transient state without explanation
patterns.review: Reload and verify the named view reconstructs its scope
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Map-list discovery
patterns.composition: Synchronize selection between map and list while preserving independent exploration
patterns.avoid: Moving the map whenever the user scrolls the list
patterns.review: Check keyboard access to the same result information
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Date-range selection
patterns.composition: Pair calendar navigation with clear start/end feedback and direct input where appropriate
patterns.avoid: Unclear inclusive endpoints and timezone assumptions
patterns.review: Try same-day, reversed, unavailable and boundary dates
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Empty search assistance
patterns.composition: Repeat the query, expose active constraints and offer a specific relaxation
patterns.avoid: Replacing no-results with promotional content
patterns.review: Can the user recover without retyping everything?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Sort controls
patterns.composition: Name the ordering dimension and direction with a stable default
patterns.avoid: Reordering results without visible reason
patterns.review: Does selection remain understandable after sort changes?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Recent activity entry
patterns.composition: Show recognizable item names, context and time groupings
patterns.avoid: Displaying inaccessible or irrelevant private activity
patterns.review: Open an item after access changes and inspect the result
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Discovery categories
patterns.composition: Use understandable categories with representative examples and clear overlap
patterns.avoid: Internal taxonomy that users cannot predict
patterns.review: Can a first-time visitor choose a plausible path?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Single-column task form
patterns.composition: Order fields by the user's mental sequence with visible labels and grouped related inputs
patterns.avoid: Multi-column layouts that obscure input order
patterns.review: Complete it using keyboard and narrow width
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Inline validation
patterns.job: Help correction at the right time
patterns.composition: Place specific errors next to fields and retain entered values
patterns.avoid: Showing errors before users have reasonably answered
patterns.review: Can users locate and correct all invalid fields?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Error summary
patterns.job: Recover from a long failed submission
patterns.composition: Summarize actionable errors and link each to its field
patterns.avoid: A generic toast as the only error indication
patterns.review: Activate each summary link and verify focus placement
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Optional fields
patterns.composition: Clearly distinguish required and optional inputs using a consistent convention
patterns.avoid: Asterisks with no explanation
patterns.review: Can users predict the minimum valid submission?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Password entry
patterns.composition: Offer visible criteria, reveal control and password-manager compatibility
patterns.avoid: Blocking paste or relying on hidden complexity rules
patterns.review: Test autofill, reveal and error recovery
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: File upload queue
patterns.composition: Show file names, individual status, cancellation and actionable failures
patterns.avoid: One spinner for many files
patterns.review: Retry one failed file without duplicating completed uploads
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Multi-step application
patterns.composition: Group steps by purpose and preserve completed answers with review navigation
patterns.avoid: Progress percentages that misrepresent effort
patterns.review: Go back, reload and resume without losing answers
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Autosave editor
patterns.composition: Show pending/saved/error states near the editing context

patterns.review: Disconnect, edit and inspect recovery behavior
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Conditional fields
patterns.composition: Keep the trigger and revealed fields spatially connected and retain sensible focus
patterns.avoid: Surprising layout jumps and stale hidden values
patterns.review: Toggle the condition and verify submitted data
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Review before submit
patterns.composition: Summarize meaningful choices with focused edit paths and exact final action
patterns.avoid: A generic confirmation with no reviewable details
patterns.review: Edit one item and return without losing the rest
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: First-value setup
patterns.composition: Ask only what enables the first useful result and defer optional preferences
patterns.avoid: A lengthy profile questionnaire before product value
patterns.review: Can users reach a meaningful outcome with minimal inputs?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Contextual permission request
patterns.composition: Connect the request to the action and explain the denial path before invoking the OS prompt
patterns.avoid: A wall of permissions at first launch
patterns.review: Deny once and confirm a usable alternative
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Import with preview
patterns.composition: Show source, sample mapping, expected changes and error handling
patterns.avoid: Importing unreviewed data into a live workspace
patterns.review: Can users identify and correct a mapping error?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Starter templates
patterns.composition: Offer a few task-based starting points with realistic previews
patterns.avoid: A giant gallery with no decision guidance
patterns.review: Can a user preview before committing?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Guided sample project
patterns.composition: Use clearly labeled sample data and an easy route to create real work

patterns.review: Can the user distinguish and remove the sample?
patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Progressive checklist
patterns.composition: List useful milestones with actual completion state and optional steps identified

patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Team invitation

patterns.title: Migration reassurance

patterns.title: Feature discovery

patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Welcome-back orientation

patterns.review: Can returning users continue where they stopped?

patterns.title: Dense operational table

patterns.title: Bulk selection

patterns.source_relationship: Further study, not a claim this product implements this card.

patterns.title: Inline table editing

patterns.title: Column customization

patterns.title: Grouped collection

patterns.title: Time-range dashboard
